title: Add Pollinations Studio to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Pollinations Studio](https://sankezhiyyds.github.io/pollinations-app) to chat
- A pure HTML/JavaScript AI generation studio with no framework dependencies. It supports image, text, audio, and video generation via the Pollinations API. Users bring their own API key (sk_ or pk_) fo

Fixes #13997

gist.headline: A studio blooms in chat
gist.blurb: Pollinations Studio has joined the chat: a small, framework-free workshop for making images, text, audio, and video. Bring an sk_ or pk_ key; the bee has already put the kettle on.
gist.summary: Added Pollinations Studio to the chat app directory, a pure HTML/JavaScript generation workspace for Pollinations image, text, audio, and video APIs using users' own sk_ or pk_ API keys.
gist.impact: Chat users can now discover and open a no-framework creative studio that puts all four Pollinations generation modalities in one browser-based workspace.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli visiting a cozy all-in-one creative studio inside a retro chat terminal: four small glowing panels represent image pixels, a text page, audio waveforms, and a video filmstrip. Polli wears a tiny artist beret and helps a friendly CRT monitor robot arrange the tools, while code-plants and flowers grow around the desk to show this is a community-made browser app.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny painter's beret, visiting a warm browser-based creative studio beside an eager CRT monitor robot. Four small retro panels glow with image pixels, text lines, audio waveforms, and a video filmstrip amid code-plants and flowers, with lime green (#ecf874) prominent against soft mint, lavender, peach, and warm cream gradients; pixel-font text reads “POLLINATIONS STUDIO”. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
